deviations_from_card: First paint drove the shape. The card put a parsed `servers` slice in the store and serverRowOf in model.ts; both are first-frame code, and that version measured +492 B over a 7 B headroom. Instead: the store mirrors `mcp_servers` unparsed (`servers?: unknown`), and a new file apps/desktop/src/modules/connectors/depth.ts (imported only by the Accounts depth's lazy chunk) holds serversOf (the defensive parse), serverRowOf and serverRowsOf. Cases 1-2 therefore assert serversOf(useConnectors.getState().servers) rather than a parsed slice; an older daemon leaves servers undefined, which reads as []. To get margin back, paragraphsOf moved model.ts -> depth.ts and INERT_ACTIONS model.ts -> fixtures.ts (import fixed in apps/desktop/e2e/connectors.e2e.test.ts, a test file outside the write set). Result: first frame 165,356 B vs 165,405 B at the base (-49 B), measured on an isolated copy of HEAD. live.tsx (first-frame) not changed, so the breadcrumb names a server by its id. Added ADR 0166 (the card named none). 'GATED' list is titled 'Gated' with a GATED mark per tool. READ-class tools are listed with AUTO as running without a card; an unknown class reads GATED.
